paper.title_en: Insights into the Pulsar Timing Array hypothesis space
paper.abstract_en: We present novel insights into the pulsar-noise model space in pulsar timing array (PTA) experiments. Through a comparative analysis of the same Parkes PTA second data release observations processed with the 2020 and 2023 pipelines, we show that data processing materially changes the distribution of posterior support across competing noise hypotheses and increases sensitivity to weak contributions such as the solar wind. A solar-wind component appears in the highest-posterior hypothesis for ten pulsars under the 2023 pipeline, against four under the 2020 pipeline, while the corresponding mean electron density estimates are consistent with PPTA DR3 results. Furthermore, hypothesis-space analysis exposes model competition and degeneracies that are hidden by single-model summaries. Approximately 75% of the pulsars retain substantial posterior support for alternative noise descriptions. Therefore, understanding the nature of the pulsar noise hypothesis space is crucial for robust inference and nanohertz gravitational-wave background searches.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文与PTA主题直接相关，通过比较不同数据处理流程对噪声假设空间的影响，提供了对PTA数据分析的重要见解，对引力波背景搜索具有实际意义。
decision.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列假设空间的洞察
decision.abstract_zh: 我们提出了对脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）实验中脉冲星噪声模型空间的新见解。通过对同一帕克斯PTA第二次数据发布观测结果使用2020年和2023年处理流程的比较分析，我们表明数据处理实质上改变了竞争性噪声假设之间后验支持的分布，并增强了对太阳风等弱贡献的敏感性。在2023年处理流程下，有十颗脉冲星的最高后验假设中出现了太阳风成分，而在2020年处理流程下只有四颗，相应的平均电子密度估计与PPTA DR3结果一致。此外，假设空间分析揭示了单模型摘要所隐藏的模型竞争和简并性。大约75%的脉冲星保留了大量的后验支持用于替代噪声描述。因此，理解脉冲星噪声假设空间的性质对于稳健推断和纳赫兹引力波背景搜索至关重要。
